title: Title: MCP Configuration Error: Unable to Configure Servers
body:
**Bug Description**
while trying to use mcp I gt this error

> /mcp 
  ⎿  No MCP servers configured. Run `claude mcp` to learn about how to configure MCP servers.

> claude mcp
  ⎿  API Error: request ended without sending any chunks

- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.42
- Feedback ID: 82db4945-c777-4949-9773-5ec6201f0692
